maddeler.e: تَاء مَفْتُوحَة • (tāʔ maftūḥa) f (plural تَاءَات مَفْتُوحَة (tāʔāt maftūḥa))
maddeler.t: Literally, “open تَاء (tāʔ)”, in contrast to its special form called تَاء مَرْبُوطَة (tāʔ marbūṭa, “tied ta'”).
g: The longer name for the letter taʼ تَاء (tāʔ) in contrast to its special form تَاء مَرْبُوطَة (tāʔ marbūṭa).
